# Oblate planets: cross-code benchmark

Machine: macOS-27.0.1-arm64-arm-64bit, Python 3.11.5; run 2026-10-10 20:58 (load average 4.1 at the start). See README.md here for the environment and the macOS build of GreenLantern.

Scenario: the spherical benchmark's transit (P = 3.456 d, a/R* = 8.8, b = 0.45, area-equivalent Rp/R* = 0.1) with projected flattening f = 0.2 and the long axis at 30 deg to the motion. Limb darkening is the one profile every code expresses exactly: I(mu) = 1 - 0.5 (1 - mu^2), MetalPlanet's hybrid2 with its pole weight 0, and the quadratic law (u1, u2) = (1.0, -0.5) for the others. Circular orbit, instantaneous fluxes. Every code's parameter mapping was checked against the others before timing.

## What each code covers

| | MetalPlanet | squishyplanet | JoJo | GreenLantern |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| limb darkening, oblate planet | hybrid2/4/5 (even powers of mu + double poles) | polynomial, any order | quadratic | quadratic |
| method | analytic (Green's theorem, partial fractions) | analytic (ALFM20 extension) | Green's theorem, numerical line integral (100 steps) | Green's theorem, Simpson's rule (2048 steps) |
| precision | fp64 (CPU) and fp32 (GPU) | fp64 | fp64 | fp32 |
| gradients | analytic VJP (fp32 kernel), autodiff (fp64) | JAX (forward Jacobian) | none | forward-mode duals |
| planet shape | projected ellipse (r, f, theta) | triaxial, 3-D orientation; projected ellipse | oblate spheroid | triaxial ellipsoid |
| exposures | contact rule, supersampling | oversampling | supersampling | binning |
| many parameter sets | native batch | jax.vmap | Python loop | native batch |

The odd powers of mu (the standard quadratic law) are not available to MetalPlanet for an oblate planet -- they have no elementary form along an ellipse; the hybrid laws are as accurate as the four-parameter Claret law for real stars (README).

## Precision vs a 30-digit mpmath integral (241 points)

| code | central transit, max | central, median | graze (b = 1.02, f = 0.4, 60 deg), max |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| MetalPlanet fp64 (CPU) | 2.22e-16 | 0.00e+00 | 1.11e-16 |
| squishyplanet 0.5.0 (JAX, fp64, CPU) | 8.88e-16 | 0.00e+00 | 3.33e-16 |
| JoJo 0.1.0 (numpy, fp64) | 1.78e-15 | 0.00e+00 | 3.00e-15 |
| MetalPlanet fp32 (GPU, Metal) | 6.61e-08 | 2.93e-10 | 8.42e-08 |
| GreenLantern 1.6 (OpenCL GPU, fp32) | 4.51e-06 | 9.84e-10 | 5.13e-06 |

The fp64 codes all reach rounding on these transits (JoJo's 100-step line integral is converged for this smooth profile); the fp32 codes sit at their precision's level, GreenLantern's set by its 2048-sample Simpson rule.

## Single light curve: wall time vs N (median)

| code | N = 1,000 | N = 10,000 | N = 100,000 | N = 1,000,000 | N = 10,000,000 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| MetalPlanet fp64 (CPU) | 13.67 ms | 56.18 ms | 443.09 ms | 4,703.33 ms | 48.0 s |
| MetalPlanet fp32 (GPU, Metal) | 1.63 ms | 1.63 ms | 1.84 ms | 6.31 ms | 54.75 ms |
| squishyplanet 0.5.0 (JAX, fp64, CPU) | 3.97 ms | 39.72 ms | 409.75 ms | 4,106.29 ms | 43.5 s |
| JoJo 0.1.0 (numpy, fp64) | 0.66 ms | 5.16 ms | 47.08 ms | 577.87 ms | 7,023.36 ms |
| GreenLantern 1.6 (OpenCL GPU, fp32) | 0.86 ms | 2.96 ms | 24.02 ms | 235.27 ms | 2,347.47 ms |

At N = 10^7 MetalPlanet's fp32 kernel is 43x faster than GreenLantern 1.6 (OpenCL GPU, fp32), 128x faster than JoJo 0.1.0 (numpy, fp64), 795x faster than squishyplanet 0.5.0 (JAX, fp64, CPU), 877x faster than MetalPlanet fp64 (CPU).

Below ~10^4 points the GPU dispatch floor (~1.6 ms, including the per-call contact solve) dominates MetalPlanet's fp32 route and the CPU codes are faster, as for spherical planets.
